svg.title: The album editor
svg.desc: The album editor, from top to bottom. The header holds the album's title and its actions: Add, Preview, Settings and Publish. Below it, the album's name as the heading, with a line of facts under it: draft or published, the count, the span of dates, and how many pictures need alt text, with Review; then its title, short description and introduction, typed in place. Then the Cover section: its heading marked Automatic, with Edit cover at the heading's end, and the cover as its band will look, with Set as cover as the other way to change it. Then the Pictures and videos section: its heading with the album's order at the end, and every item in a grid of thumbnails in that order, some selected, with a text card across the grid between two rows. Beside the grid, the viewer shows one item large with its words to edit: caption, description, alt text with Suggest, date taken and place, downloads, and the other albums it's in. A selection bar shows under the grid while items are selected, with what they can do.

g.text: Draft · 21 items · March to May 2026 · 7 need alt text · Review
